bullets: The default starting price for new agentic advertising campaigns was set to 300 cents ($3.00 per click), and the TIER 2 maximum charge now tracks this new default price.
The assistant now performs one verification pass using available tools before ending a coding turn.
The CLI now collects terminal, session, and agent details for ad auctions and reports per-impression hover, visibility, and click timing.
The model catalog includes a faster experimental DeepSeek Flash Fast model for code tasks, though it remains turned off in the public model picker.
Added a new optional field to the Freebuff system tracking when a paid subscription was paused due to a failed renewal payment.
